hero.title: How support teams use an AI agent to clear repeat questions.
hero.body: Order status, delivery, sizing and help centre questions arrive all day. These teams let Steps AI answer them, so people can focus on the customers who need help.

stories.attribution: Maya Patel | Head of E-commerce | North & Pine
stories.excerpt: The order-status questions have almost disappeared from our support queue. We still get the odd one, but it’s nowhere near what it used to be.

Size, stock, shipping, and returns were probably half of our daily messages. We had saved replies for most of them because the team was answering the same questions all day. StepsAI handles most of those conversations now, and support has a lot more time for the customers who actually need help.

stories.attribution: Sofia Alvarez | Customer Operations Manager | Casa Noma
stories.excerpt: Monday mornings are noticeably quieter now. We used to open WhatsApp to a wall of delivery, stock, and sizing questions from the weekend, and someone would spend the first hour or two just working through them. Most of those get answered as they come in now. The team really only gets involved when a customer needs something more specific.

stories.attribution: Jonathan Reed | VP, Customer Success | Stacklane
stories.excerpt: Our help center is pretty big, and customers weren’t finding half of what was already there. Now they just ask the question normally and get the relevant answer. Support still handles the harder stuff, but we get far fewer tickets asking for information that was already sitting in our docs.

capabilities.title: What the AI support agent does.

items.title: Answer order and delivery questions
items.body: The agent checks your store and shipping tools before it replies.

items.title: Answer from your help content
items.body: Customers ask in their own words and get the relevant answer from your docs and FAQs.

items.title: Hand over the harder cases
items.body: The agent raises a ticket or passes the conversation to your team with the history attached.
